text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in machine learning and NLP. I enjoy taking on tasks that require careful research, strong attention to detail, and consistent execution, and I’d be glad to support your ongoing link-building work.

Although my background is in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, I’m comfortable working with data-heavy, process-driven tasks that require accuracy and reliability. I understand the importance of following strict guidelines, and I can approach your SEO workflow with the same methodical mindset used in technical projects: research thoroughly, verify requirements, and deliver work that is clean, relevant, and easy to review.

For this role, I can help with site research, identifying suitable websites for article submission, and preparing unique content for guest posting using ChatGPT or other relevant tools. I also understand the need to focus only on legitimate, spam-free websites that meet your standards, including Google indexing, DR 35+, organic traffic of at least 2000 as reported by Semrush, and niche or category relevance. I’m also comfortable working with follow links only and making sure submitted backlinks are ready for approval before payment.

I value clear communication and ongoing collaboration, which makes me a good fit for a recurring task-based role like this one. If needed, I can stay aligned with your requirements, adapt to your review process, and keep each submission consistent with your conditions. I’m also comfortable working with unique articles for every submission and keeping the process organized so nothing gets overlooked.

If you’re looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and committed to long-term work, I’d be happy to contribute to your link-building efforts. I’m ready to discuss the project details and get started.
